title: Women's Bookish – Do Not Sell My Books Embroidered Zip Hoodie
who: the reader with a will and a very specific wish about her shelves, zipped on over a tee at the used bookstore and on the reading chair at night.
art: A tall stack of old leather books tied with a big ribbon bow, a bunch of lilies on top and a melting candle beside it, drawn in engraved rose and cream line with a worn print texture.
headline: DO NOT SELL MY BOOKS
inks: cream and rose on Black and Navy, maroon and navy on Ash
layout_story: DO NOT SELL MY BOOKS stands in heavy capitals beside the stack with AT MY FUNERAL. beneath it, the second pair of lines a touch wider than the first
layout_faq: DO NOT SELL MY BOOKS and AT MY FUNERAL. in heavy capitals beside the stack
chest: a small stack of three books with a bookmark ribbon
warm2: cold libraries, drafty reading nooks and the walk home from the bookstore
gift_line: for the reader who has already told the family what happens to the shelves.
seo_desc: A book lover zip up hoodie: DO NOT SELL MY BOOKS AT MY FUNERAL. on the back beside a stack of books, plus an embroidered book stack on the chest.
